prep_strands_data: prep hair strands data by converting world coordinates to TBN space and building UV texel maps
decode_strands_code: decode a strand shape code into predicted 3D points using the StrandCodec model
get_neural_representations: get neural representations for all strands by encoding and optimizing latent codes with L2 and directional loss
denoise_on_strds: denoise regular TBN strands using adaptive K-means clustering to remove outlier hair strands
interpolation_on_strds: interpolate missing hair strands in sparse regions using KNN weighted averaging on the texture map
